# package client

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ieee20305/client"
```

Package client is an IEEE 2030.5 client: it reads and writes the resources of one server over HTTPS with mutual TLS, identifying the device by its certificate.

A Client resolves the hrefs of resources against its server and refuses links and redirects to another server. It reads documents with Get, GetList and Fetch, starting from DeviceCapability, and writes them with Post, Put and Delete. A failure is a \*ieee20305.StatusError carrying the server's Error document when it sent one, or matches ieee20305.ErrProtocol or ieee20305.ErrTimeout. With csipaus.Codec as its Codec, a client reads and writes CSIP-AUS documents.

A device registers with Register: it finds its EndDevice in the server's EndDeviceList by the SFDI of its certificate (IdentityOf), or creates it. Registration retrieves what the server registered, and CheckPIN checks the PIN the device was given out of band.

	c, err := client.New(client.Config{
		Server:     "https://utility.example:443/dcap",
		HTTPClient: client.NewHTTPClient(deviceCert, serverCAs),
	})
	dcap, err := c.DeviceCapability(ctx)
	ed, _, err := c.Register(ctx, dcap.EndDeviceListLink.Href, client.IdentityOf(deviceCert.Leaf))
	reg, err := c.Registration(ctx, ed)
	err = client.CheckPIN(reg, 111115)

Iterate pages through a list and Walk through the resource tree. Subscribe asks for notifications, which NewNotificationHandler receives. Config.RetryPolicy, Logger and Metrics are the plug points of the module (see OBSERVABILITY.md).

Package agent builds the behaviour of a device on these calls: it registers, checks the PIN and polls the device's resources.

## Variables

```go
var ErrNotRegistered = errors.New("ieee20305: the server has not registered the device")
```

ErrNotRegistered is matched by a call that needs the registration of an EndDevice the server has not registered: it has no RegistrationLink.

```go
var ErrPINMismatch = errors.New("ieee20305: registration PIN mismatch")
```

ErrPINMismatch is matched by CheckPIN when the PIN of a Registration is not the one the device expects: the server registered someone else, or the PIN was entered wrongly on the server.

## Functions

### func CheckPIN

```go
func CheckPIN(r *ieee20305.Registration, pin uint32) error
```

CheckPIN reports whether r carries the PIN the device was given out of band, as a device must check before it trusts the server. A mismatch matches ErrPINMismatch.

#### func (Client) FindEndDevice

```go
func (c *Client) FindEndDevice(ctx context.Context, listHref string, id Identity) (*ieee20305.EndDevice, error)
```

FindEndDevice returns the EndDevice of the device id in the EndDeviceList at listHref, or nil if the list has none. It asks the server to select the device by its SFDI, and pages through the whole list in case the server ignores the selection, up to Config.MaxListItems devices (ErrProtocol beyond).

#### func (Client) Iterate

```go
func (c *Client) Iterate(ctx context.Context, href string, pageSize uint32, fn func(item any) error) error
```

Iterate calls fn with every item of the list resource at href, a page of pageSize items at a time (all the server gives when zero), until the list ends or fn returns an error, which Iterate returns. A list longer than Config.MaxListItems fails with ErrProtocol.

#### func (Client) Register

```go
func (c *Client) Register(ctx context.Context, listHref string, id Identity) (ed *ieee20305.EndDevice, created bool, err error)
```

Register makes sure the EndDeviceList at listHref has an EndDevice for the device id. It returns the one FindEndDevice finds or else posts a new one, with the device's SFDI and LFDI, and reads back what the server created. created reports whether it posted one.

#### func (Client) Subscribe

```go
func (c *Client) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, list, resource, notificationURI string, limit uint32) (string, error)
```

Subscribe posts a subscription of the resource at resource to the SubscriptionList at list: the server posts a Notification to notificationURI, an https URL of a NotificationHandler, when the resource changes, with at most limit items of a list. It returns the href of the subscription, for Unsubscribe.

#### func (Client) Walk

```go
func (c *Client) Walk(ctx context.Context, root string, opts WalkOptions, visit func(Step) error) error
```

Walk visits the resource at root and the resources its links lead to, breadth first, each once: lists with their items, and the links of the items, up to opts.MaxResources resources. A link to a resource the server does not have (404) is skipped. visit's error stops the walk and is returned.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// Server is the URL of the server, such as https://utility.example:8443.
	// The hrefs of resources are resolved against it, and the client does
	// not follow links or redirects to another scheme, host or port, or to
	// a URL with userinfo: its device certificate identifies it to this
	// server only. The host of a link matches in ASCII case only: another
	// spelling of the server, with a trailing dot or the default port, is
	// another server. Required; the scheme must be https.
	Server string
	// DeviceCapabilityPath is the path of the DeviceCapability resource;
	// DefaultDeviceCapabilityPath when empty.
	DeviceCapabilityPath string
	// HTTPClient makes the requests. Its transport holds the device
	// certificate and the CAs that verify the server: see NewHTTPClient.
	// Required.
	HTTPClient *http.Client
	// Codec encodes and decodes documents; package ieee20305 when nil.
	Codec Codec
	// UserAgent is sent with every request when not empty.
	UserAgent string
	// MaxResponseBytes limits the size of a response body; 1 MiB when zero.
	MaxResponseBytes int64
	// RetryPolicy decides whether a request that failed is sent again:
	// ieee20305.NoRetry() when nil; ieee20305.ExponentialBackoff{} retries
	// what may succeed (unavailable, 5xx, timeout) a few times. GET, HEAD,
	// PUT and DELETE are retried; POST only with RetryPOST.
	RetryPolicy ieee20305.RetryPolicy
	// RetryPOST lets RetryPolicy retry POSTs too. A POST whose answer is
	// lost may have taken effect: send it again only to a server that
	// stores it once (go-ieee20305's server does so for EndDevices,
	// Responses and mirrors).
	RetryPOST bool
	// Metrics receives the client's requests, to count and time them; none
	// when nil.
	Metrics Metrics
	// Logger receives the client's log (see ieee20305.Logger): a Debug
	// line per request. None when nil.
	Logger ieee20305.Logger
	// MaxListItems limits the items Iterate and Walk read of one list, as
	// a list could claim to have any number: 100000 when zero.
	MaxListItems uint32
}
```

Config configures a Client.

### type Metrics

```go
type Metrics interface {
	OnRequest(method, path string)
	OnResponse(method, path string, status int, d time.Duration)
	OnError(method, path string, d time.Duration, err error)
}
```

Metrics receives the requests of a client, to count and time them: set it as Config.Metrics. Each method is called once per call of the client (a Get, a Post, ...), whatever its retries: OnRequest when it starts, and OnResponse or OnError when it ends, with its duration including retries. path is the path of the request, an href of the server; aggregate it (by WADL resource, say) before using it as a label.

The methods are called synchronously from the goroutines of the calls: they must be safe for concurrent use, quick, and must not block. Embed NopMetrics to implement only some.

### type NotificationHandler

```go
type NotificationHandler struct {

	// by subscription

}
```

NotificationHandler is the http.Handler of the notifications a server posts to a device: serve it over TLS that verifies the server's certificate (security.ServerTLSConfig with the CAs of the server).

The server may send a notification more than once; the handler passes on a notification only when its content differs from the previous one of the same subscription. The notifications of a subscription are handled one at a time. It is safe for concurrent use.
